outcome: Congenital pseudoaneurysm of the mitral-aortic intervalvular fibrosa
cohort: A neonate with severe Marfan syndrome.
finding: A neonate with severe Marfan syndrome presented with persistent atrial tachycardia, biventricular dysfunction, and a congenital pseudoaneurysm of the mitral-aortic intervalvular fibrosa, with emergent testing identifying a FBN1 pathological variant.
